cv.summary: Flutter engineer with 3 years of software engineering experience shipping production mobile apps to the App Store and Google Play. Recent work includes refactoring a dating app to Riverpod and Clean Architecture, and integrating Firebase and BFF services into a sports platform at Reality Sports.
skills: Mobile & Frontend: Flutter, Clean Architecture, Riverpod, GoRouter, Provider, GetX, Unit/Widget/Integration Testing, Mockito
Core Languages: Dart, Kotlin, Swift, Java, Python, SQL, Bash, C/C++
DevOps, Cloud & Release: Firebase (Auth, Crashlytics, Remote Config), Google Play Console, TestFlight, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Git, Docker, Docker Compose, Linux

email.subject: Flutter Developer application – Mohamed Hassen Amara
email.full_text:
Subject: Flutter Developer application – Mohamed Hassen Amara

Hi Adam,

I'm applying for the Flutter Developer role at Healy World and wanted to reach out directly.

At Reality Sports I built the Flutter frontend for a sports management app with 10+ screens and integrated 15+ RESTful backend services for real-time data sync. I also set up GitHub Actions pipelines for automated builds and releases, and refactored a legacy codebase under Clean Architecture, cutting the app's binary size by 15%.

Would you be able to take a look at my attached CV and let me know if you'd recommend me for the role?

Best regards,
Mohamed Hassen Amara
